svg.text: Cut a blank 436 mm wide by 215 mm. Fold the bottom 25 mm forward

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Flange: two 6.5 mm holes, 80 mm each side of centre, 13 mm from the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: plate (M6 screws into the rear cross member's rivet nuts).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Upright: two 4.2 mm holes 120 mm up, 20 mm each side of centre,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: for the fender's front tab (4 mm rivets).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Round the top corners to 10 mm; deburr all edges.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: stands between the rails, 2 mm clear of each, its back face

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: level with the rails' rear ends; 190 mm tall.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: 20 mm or more from the belt as it goes round the rear roller.
